paragraphs.text: Cards from Marvel Super Heroes as compared to cards from earlier sets.
Aerial Doombot is strictly better than Cloud Pirates , Cloud Sprite , Flying Men , Manta Riders , Sea Eagle , Thought Nibbler , and Zephyr Sprite .
Dark Deed is strictly better than Flatten , Grasp of Darkness , Lash of the Whip , Last Gasp , Scorpion's Sting , Strangling Spores , Tar Snare , Throttle , and Tomb Hex .
Dependable Quinjet is strictly better than Manalith .
Depower is strictly better than Befuddle and Bewilder .
Dismissive Denial is strictly better than Traumatic Visions .
Evil's Thrall is strictly better than Act of Treason and Threaten .
Hero in Training is strictly better than Roving Harper .
Hour of Defeat is strictly better than Chill to the Bone , Eviscerate , and Impale .
Kingpin's Enforcers is strictly better than Soulreaper of Mogis .
Pet Avengers is strictly better than Magnigoth Sentry and Plated Spider .
Pym Particles is strictly better than Enter the Enigma and Slip Through Space .
Raft Security Officer is strictly better than Checkpoint Officer .
Serpent Specialist is strictly better than Ankle Biter , Fang of Shigeki , Moss Viper , Sedge Scorpion , and Tajuru Blightblade .
S.H.I.E.L.D. Deployment Drone is strictly better than Dragoon's Wyvern .
Surveillance Room is strictly better than Painted Bluffs , Planar Nexus , Shimmering Grotto , and Unknown Shores .
Team Tactics is strictly better than Ticked Off .
Visions of Villainy is strictly better than Succumb to Temptation .
We Say Thee Nay! is strictly better than It'll Quench Ya! and Quench .
Agent of Atlas is strictly worse than Seeker of the Way .
Frozen in Ice is strictly worse than Flood the Engine .
The ten gainland s are functional reprints of the original gainlands from Khans of Tarkir .
Hawkeye's Shot is a functional reprint of Banish from Edoras .
Rapid Rescue is a functional reprint of Seed of Hope .
Stolen Stark Tech is a functional reprint of Bladed Battle-Fan .
Super Villain Lockup is a functional reprint of Seal Away .
Surveillance Room is a functional reprint of Conduit Pylons and Hidden Grotto .
The Wasp, Janet Van Dyne is a functional reprint of Momo, Rambunctious Rascal .
